WHAT LEDGERLY DOES

A quieter month-end.

The routine work happens as the month goes, so the close is a review, not a rebuild.

01
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction is sorted as it lands, using your existing rules and cost centres. Uncategorised spend gets a clear home, not a growing list at month end.

02
Duplicate detection

Ledgerly compares amounts, merchants, and timing across every connected card to catch repeat charges as they happen. Matches arrive with the evidence, ready to confirm or dismiss.

03
Month-end close

Your ledger stays current all month, leaving the close to review instead of reconstruction. When the period is ready, export it straight into your accounting system.

HOW IT WORKS

Three steps.
No loose ends.

A short path from card swipe to clean ledger. Each step builds on the last, with nothing re-keyed along the way.

01
Connect your cards

Securely connect your corporate cards and bring every transaction into one reviewable place.

02
Review flagged spend

Ledgerly groups the spend and flags what needs a human eye, with the context already attached.

03
Export to your ledger

Send categorised, reconciled activity to the accounting system your team already uses.
